purpose: Bounded primary-source comparison for the review of PROTECT01's per-record signed-logit-margin projection.

searches.query: arXiv Gradient Episodic Memory for Continual Learning Lopez-Paz Ranzato 2017
arXiv Efficient Lifelong Learning with A-GEM Chaudhry Ranzato 2018

sources.title: Gradient Episodic Memory for Continual Learning
sources.review_use: Checked GEM's stated loss-based first-order constraints and closest-gradient projection formulation. Supports describing PROTECT01 as related projection precedent while distinguishing its per-record signed-logit-margin rows from GEM's prior-task episodic-loss constraints.

sources.title: Efficient Lifelong Learning with A-GEM
sources.review_use: Checked A-GEM's single averaged reference-gradient constraint and its stated distinction from GEM's multiple individual loss constraints; used to keep the source comparison precise.

limits: Two primary papers were consulted. Search-result excerpts from other pages were not relied on. No files were downloaded and no code, model, scorer, gradient, derivative, QP solver, or experiment was run.
